description: Send a question or request to one factory: customization (logo, colour, packaging), samples, quantities above stock or outside the price tiers, lead times, anything the listing does not settle. Give product_id (or supplier_id for a general question), a kind, the message in English and any structured details. The factory's AI assistant answers at once from the factory's own data; anything needing a person is forwarded and the factory replies in the same inquiry (poll get_inquiry). Do not share contact or payment details; Moqway handles payment.

customization.description: Logo, colour, size, material, packaging changes

needed_by.description: Date or period, e.g. 2027-02-15 or 'within 6 weeks'

name: send_inquiry
title: Ask a factory
